name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Domain = chapter_event_handler; descriptor = dispatch index 0x20 plus ch10_dialog. The '_20' is the per-event handler-table index (table at 0x51B91, dispatched range 0x00-0x2E), a meaningful domain ID, NOT an address residue (self addr 0x34BE2 != 0x20; xref entry at 0x51C11 holds 0x34BE2). The '_10' is chapter 10 (valid chapter ID 1-30; verified vs chapter_10 walkthrough). 'dialog' matches the category (dialog-only beat). Consistent with the entire sibling handler family in chevt1.c.
purpose: Chapter 10 turn-event slot 0 handler (dispatched as idx 0x20 of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91): the reinforcement-arrival dialog beat that reloads portrait set 1 and shows chapter-text dialog page 1 when the player's 5th turn ends.
logic_summary: Straight-line, dialog-only. Ignores its dispatch arg. Calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1) then fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=1, 0xA0000 VGA base, 0x140 stride, 0xCD/0x4C window X/Y, 0x4A style, 0x13 max lines, 1 wait-flag). No branch, no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used. In the original binary the function is a 5-byte adapter stub (PUSH 0x28) that falls through (no JMP; 0x34BE2 -> 0x34BE7) into the shared body fd2_show_chapter_dialog_with_portrait_set_1 @ 0x34BE7; the pushed 0x28 is the __CHK frame size consumed by that body's compiler-injected CALL __CHK. The body's effect is reproduced inline in src for Layer-2 equivalence. Sibling handler_05 @ 0x34D68 reaches the same body via 'PUSH 0x28; JMP'.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl dispatch argument from the per-event handler table at 0x51B91. Never read by this handler (cast to void). Standard name used across all sibling handlers in chevt1.c.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the dispatch-table convention, consistent with siblings, no address residue. Body never reads it.
